OUR STORY

A familiar place.
A fresh chapter.

Mirror Lake Retreat has a long history in the Hudson Valley… and now, a bright future as well. Founded by the Church of the Nazarene as The Taconic Retreat and Conference Center, in 2021 the property underwent a full scale renovation and is now positioned as the Hudson Valley’s premier camping resort.

We love being the perfect outdoor escape for people of all ages and walks of life! We have a diverse range of accommodations that are perfect for group gatherings, corporate retreats, family outings, couple’s romantic getaways and more! Being conveniently located 90 minutes out of New York City and only a 15 minute drive from beautiful Rhinebeck and Red Hook, NY provides our guests with great shopping and restaurant options from lovely scenic downtowns. Not to mention, Dutchess County is a treasure trove filled with all kinds of local attractions .

We invite you to learn more about our campground’s storied history and our dedicated team who help families, friends, and groups make unforgettable memories on our property.

Frequently Asked Questions

Still curious? Give us a call ↗
I used to visit Taconic Retreat. Is this the same place?

Yes! It’s the same physical place and has the same ownership; however, Mirror Lake Retreat has been fully renovated and reimagined as a family campground rather than a conference center. While we honor our history, we also look toward the future with the goal of introducing this beautiful corner of the Hudson Valley to a broader subset of people.

I see that Mirror Lake Retreat is a ministry partnership of the Metro New York District Church of the Nazarene. Do I need to be a church member to stay at Mirror Lake Retreat?

No, Mirror Lake Retreat welcomes guests of all faiths and beliefs.

What time is check-in and check-out?

Check-in is at 3:00 p.m. and check-out is at 11:00 a.m. Please contact us if you need to check in or out between 9pm and 7am.

What is your pet policy?

Pets are only allowed onsite with a non-refundable $100 fee. Outside of accommodations, pets must be leashed and accompanied by their owner at all times. Guests must provide proof of up-to-date vaccinations upon check-in. All pet droppings are the responsibility of the pet owner and must be properly disposed of immediately in a tied or zip locked plastic bag and placed in a trash receptacle. Any pet that is intimidating, destructive, dangerous, or noisy will be asked to leave, along with their owners. Please let us know in your booking if you plan to bring pets and contact us if you wish to see our full policy.

What’s your smoking policy?

Smoking is not allowed anywhere on Mirror Lake Retreat property, including all accommodations, buildings, and outdoor areas.

What is your alcohol policy?

Alcohol is not allowed anywhere on Mirror Lake Retreat property, including all accommodations, buildings, and outdoor areas.

Does Mirror Lake Retreat have quiet hours?

Yes, our quiet hours are from 10pm-7am.
